transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I conducted your follow-up check after your cataract surgery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start with light gardening activities about 1 week after surgery, but make sure to wear protective eyewear. It's also recommended to avoid getting water in your eye, especially in the first month. After 1 week, you can go back to light gardening, but avoid strenuous activities like lifting heavy objects or digging.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Alright, that makes sense. Next, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should continue to use the preservative-free eye drops as prescribed. If you're running out, you can get some more from your GP. It's safe to use them as usual, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Got it, thanks. I've noticed I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and just seems brighter than usual, you can try wearing sunglasses when you're outside. But if it's severe or accompanied by redness and pain, we may need to assess it further.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for explaining. One more question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, but it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it's okay.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information. I don't have any more questions at the moment.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure to help. I'm glad I could answer your questions about your cataract surgery recovery. Now, I just need to confirm that all your questions have been answered. Can you please confirm that everything has been answered to your satisfaction?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, everything has been answered to my satisfaction. Thank you!
